head: Eyes Down turns your iPhone into a bingo caller with a board on the TV
dek: Eyes Down calls bingo numbers from your iPhone or iPad and shows the ball and board on a TV or projector, while your controls stay on your device. It was #81 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 9 November.
details: It connects by AirPlay or cable and shows a live preview of what the room sees. It's made for family nights, schools, churches, clubs and charity events. It costs $2.99 with no in-app purchases, by Alexander Scott, and needs iOS 18.
means: A bingo night needs no ball cage, just a phone and a TV.
todo: Find Eyes Down in the App Store and connect your TV with AirPlay or a cable.
